string-array.name: help_library
string-array.item: Touch and hold a photo to select it. Then tap more photos.
Pinch to change how many photos fit across.
Use the filter button to show picks, ratings or edited photos.
Rejected photos are hidden. Tap Rejects to see them.
Pick or reject while culling: open a photo and use the flag buttons.

string-array.name: help_viewer
string-array.item: Swipe left or right to move between photos.
Double tap to zoom. Pinch for more.
Swipe up for details about the shot.
Tap Edit to open the photo in the editor.

string-array.name: help_editor
string-array.item: Drag a slider to change it. Double tap its name to reset.
Tap the number to type an exact value.
Hold the photo to see the original.
Undo and Redo are at the top. Your edits save by themselves.
Tap the photo to hide the panel.

string-array.name: help_masks
string-array.item: A mask changes only part of the photo. Add one, then set what it does.
Subtract takes an area away. Intersect keeps only where two masks overlap.
AI tools download a model the first time. Use Wi-Fi if you can.

string-array.name: help_remove
string-array.item: Paint over what you want gone. Heal and Clone copy from nearby. Remove uses AI.

string-array.name: help_export
string-array.item: Export makes a new file. Your original is never changed.
Choose a size and format, then tap Export. You can leave the app while it runs.
Find your photos in Pictures/Rawline, or in the folder you chose.
